evidenceCases.assertion: Golden package graphs produce a stable canonical diff, digest, and ordered receipt independent of presentation bytes.
Alternate legacy-compatible and draft-safe upgrades remain preview-only until canonical writer promotion.
Bounded sandbox conformance covers two package shapes and all inherited lifecycle boundaries without activating a package.
Promotion receipt and active pointer are committed atomically and remain immutable under rollback or forward fix.
Stale, forged, mismatched, concurrent, and hybrid pointer updates fail without partial canonical state.
Migration, backup, restore, clone, fork, import, export, journal replay, search, delete, Erase, and compatibility preserve exact bytes and identity.
Unknown schema, duplicate identity, changed source revision, incompatible active session, protected data, cancellation, and storage failure return typed closed outcomes.
The hydrated fence is exactly 107 paths: 92 existing and 15 new, with zero overlap against the frozen S10 reservation.
All activation and release flags remain false pending later acceptance and S10 reconciliation.

requiredBehaviors.requirement: Typed canonical package graphs compare independent of locale, order, whitespace, and serializer bytes; unchanged, additive draft-safe, migration-required, active-session-incompatible, and invalid outcomes are distinct.
The draft upgrade preview is nonpersistent, nonfinal, exact-source-revision bound, and applies only through the existing C36 draft writer.
A bounded local sandbox validates two package shapes, lifecycle integration, localization, accessibility, report, backup, restore, search, replay, and brand/state conformance without activation.
One canonical writer transaction binds package bytes, semantic diff, sandbox result, actor authority, exact candidate, registry pointer, and rollback compatibility.
The active pointer changes only with a durable immutable promotion receipt and never mixes old and new generations.
Schema V17 and records 16 migration, backup/restore, clone/fork, import/export, replay, search, delete/Erase, compatibility, and forward-fix dispositions are explicit.
Unknown, corrupt, stale, protected-data, storage, cancellation, permission, capability, concurrency, and forged receipt conditions fail closed without partial canonical success.
This lane is PASS_STATIC_PROVISIONAL and native, hosted, adoption, acceptance, and release flags remain false.
